phase2_structure.description: Phase 2 generates career paths based on Phase 1 subject ratings using weighted algorithms

career_generation_logic.algorithm: Each career has weights for 3-5 most relevant Phase 1 subjects. Weights sum to 1.0. Career score calculated for each user based on their Phase 1 ratings.
career_generation_logic.sorting: Careers ranked by score, highest first. Recommend top 8-15 careers based on weights.
